title: Aerated Mediterranean Garlic Stew
description: A light, flavorful, and aerated stew perfect for meal prep. It's a unique blend of mediterranean flavors with a savory and slightly spicy kick from the garlic.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for 2-3 minutes until fragrant.
Add the diced onion and sauté for another 2-3 minutes until softened.
Add the can of diced tomatoes, artichoke hearts, and Kalamata olives. Stir well to combine.
Add the feta cheese, fresh parsley, lemon juice, salt, black pepper, and garam masala. Stir well to combine.
Cover the pot and bring the stew to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let it cook for 20-25 minutes or until the flavors have melded together.
Remove the pot from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Use an immersion blender to aerate the stew to your desired consistency.
Return the pot to the heat and let it simmer for another 5-10 minutes or until the stew has reached your desired consistency.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with additional fresh parsley if desired.
Store any leftovers in the fridge for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 2 months.
When reheating, you can add a splash of lemon juice or water to thin the stew to your desired consistency.
